summary: English uses forms of be across most copular domains; existential there + be is distinct and possession normally uses have.

semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: be + result-state adjective/participle; distinguish passive readings
semantic_map.SEM.ORIGIN_AFFILIATION: be from / be + nationality or affiliation
semantic_map.SEM.MATERIAL_COMPOSITION: be made of/from; restricted be of + material
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: not default; dedicated have is ordinary
